query.sql:
-- A script writing log lines (stdout) and warnings (stderr) for 30 seconds.
for i = 1, 30 do
  if i % 7 == 0 then
    io.stderr:write(("disk %d%% full\n"):format(80 + i % 20))
  else
    io.write(("job %d done in %d ms\n"):format(i, math.random(5, 90)))
  end
  io.stdout:flush()
  vim.uv.sleep(1000)
end
